aquifers.geometry_notes: USGS principal aquifer geometry shown for national-scale display only. It represents the shallowest principal aquifer extent and not the full underground system.

aquifers.description_short: A major groundwater system with irrigation dominating withdrawals across Wyoming. The map uses a county-footprint fallback for display.
aquifers.description_long: In 2015, the USGS estimated about 3.76 Mgal/d of groundwater withdrawals associated with the Wyoming Tertiary aquifers. Irrigation accounted for about 57 percent of the total, with the largest shares concentrated in Wyoming. Because the official principal-aquifer shapefile does not expose a standalone polygon for this aquifer, the map footprint shows the set of 6 counties attached to source rows.
aquifers.geometry_notes: County-footprint fallback shown for national display only. The USGS principal-aquifer shapefile does not expose a standalone polygon for this source aquifer, so the map uses the 6 counties that carry 2015 withdrawal rows instead.
